method: Viewed actual source artwork, producer masks/contact sheets, independently extracted native-resolution motion and last-two/first-two seam crops. Fully decoded all 84 frames per video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask and brightness metrics. Compared Oxford source and video candle at 4x enlargement. Verified SHA-256 before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, motion mask, producer contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples of the fireplace and foreground candle, and last-two/first-two seam crops. Library geometry, books, windows, globe, chair and candle body remain stable. Fireplace motion appears localized and natural in sampled frames.

Foreground candle has two separated flame silhouettes, with a displaced bright flame beside the retained source flame. The source has one flame and wick. This is visible at native resolution throughout sampled frames and corroborated by an enlarged source/video comparison. Passing global metrics do not detect this compositing defect.

Independent full decode of all 84 frames reproduces seam ratio 0.8940 and outside-mask change 0.000073. Loop boundary samples do not show an obvious additional geometry jump, but the persistent doubled flame prevents visual approval.
requiredChanges: Remove the misaligned foreground-candle animation or repair its compositing so the source candle has a single flame, then re-render and independently review the new hash.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, motion mask, producer contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples of pool water, waterfall and vapor, and last-two/first-two seam crops. Both capybaras, faces, citrus, stones, railings, roof, lanterns and foreground objects retain their source positions and shapes.

Pool ripples, narrow waterfall and transparent pool vapor change gently in samples. No duplicated animals, displaced citrus, obvious mask edge or solid smoke patch is visible. Animal silhouettes remain clear and singular at the moving-water boundaries.

Independent full decode of all 84 frames reproduces seam ratio 1.1311 and outside-mask change 0.000423. Last/first samples retain consistent geometry and restrained brightness. Perceived speed and integrated sound remain unverified.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
